topic: Accessing Kubernetes logs and data visualization
summary_markdown:
The conversation initially focused on finding a user interface (UI) method to view Kubernetes pod logs and process statistics without needing direct SSH access. It was noted that the native Kubernetes web UI dashboard provides this functionality.

Later, the discussion shifted to accessing data visualization tools. [p1] provided links for internal resources: one for general cluster viewing (`k8s.allunite.local`) and another for a data exploration tool (Superset). To use Superset effectively, someone was instructed to navigate to the SQL Lab section and save any necessary queries as datasets.
decisions: The native Kubernetes web UI dashboard is confirmed as a viable way to view pod logs and cluster status in a UI.
Internal links for k8s access and Superset data exploration were shared.
action_items: Someone needs to determine which specific data sets are required by different teams/personnel.
